description:
A user with visual impairment is reporting issues reading the schedule. You need to test the Flight Crew View app's large text support.

1. Go to Android Settings > Accessibility (or Display) > Font size.
2. Set the Font Size to the 'Largest' possible setting.
3. Return to the Flight Crew View app's Friends list.
4. Take a screenshot of the list with large text active and save it as '/sdcard/large_text_test.png'.
5. Create a file '/sdcard/readability_result.txt' containing 'READABLE: YES' if the text looks okay, or 'READABLE: NO' if it is broken.

IMPORTANT: Leave the font size set to 'Largest' when you finish so we can verify the setting.
